title: 3043. Find the Length of the Longest Common Prefix

examples.explanation: There are 3 pairs (arr1[i], arr2[j]): - The longest common prefix of (1, 1000) is 1. - The longest common prefix of (10, 1000) is 10. - The longest common prefix of (100, 1000) is 100. The longest common prefix is 100 with a length of 3.
There exists no common prefix for any pair (arr1[i], arr2[j]), hence we return 0. Note that common prefixes between elements of the same array do not count.
